findings.implementation: SqliteCoreSnapshotAdapter reads the frozen Core authority and writes deterministic aggregate state through AssetStore.
BackupBarrier carries an independent core_event_high_water and CoreSnapshot capture/verification requires exact equality.
PackageStoreArchiveAdapter emits deterministic ZIP_STORED artifacts; service separates artifact SHA-256 from SDK semantic package_hash and calls verify_package on create/verify/restore.
P3 is restricted to plugin_db/metadata and bundle verification requires exactly one core_db at core/core.db.
Creation and bundle replay require state_hash to equal the digest encoded by state_asset_id.
Verification rebuilds workspace IDs from frozen SQLite and enforces workspace versus full/data scope and workspace_snapshot_hash rules.
Direct Asset columns are closed and structured JSON uses strict parsing while scanning both keys and values.
Asset metadata is parsed against the exact AssetMetadata field set and exact Python scalar types.
Restore source_root_id must equal verified manifest library_root_id before replay or staging.
Stage marker v2 binds state and full lexical target parent; cleanup accepts only the exact hidden generation and never a published target.
Lexical no-reparse checks precede resolve/read for roots, control files, target components and publication boundaries.
The verified callback runs before final bundle/report/marker validation; no mutable staging callback runs after final prepublish validation.
Ephemeral barrier tokens are excluded from the durable receipt.
The internal receipt and compatibility evidence use exact closed field sets, scalar/list/hash gates, and created_at binding.
cleanup_backup_staging provides exact generation recovery and create_backup reuses a fully verified equivalent published bundle after a publish-window interruption.
